description:
formula_totals, product_totals and functions on causal.rs have no production caller; tests/fz2_cli.rs is the only consumer. They are plain aggregations over already-public event data, so they need no lib privileges.

Move them into tests/fz2_cli.rs as local helpers. causal.rs itself stays production -- public_trace.rs and pull.rs consume it.

Done when: the three methods are gone from causal.rs, fz2_cli.rs computes its own totals, and the full gate is green.

comments.text:
Investigated: the filed plan does not work, and the real finding is larger.

Why 'move the 3 helpers into tests/fz2_cli.rs' fails:
- functions() is on CanonTables and reads the PRIVATE field self.functions (causal.rs:122). Moving it out would require making that field pub -- a wider surface than the one being removed.
- formula_totals/product_totals are not fz2_cli-only. src/telemetry/public_trace_test.rs calls them at 10+ sites. Moving them into fz2_cli.rs would duplicate them, not relocate them.

The real finding: src/telemetry/causal.rs (1960 lines) has ZERO production consumers.
- pull.rs's three causal:: references are all inside its #[cfg(test)] mod tests (opens at 2559).
- public_trace.rs is itself a #[cfg(test)]-gated module.
- No CLI or binary use.

It cannot simply be gated, because tests/fz2_cli.rs consumes it as an external crate and cannot see cfg(test) -- the same constraint that drove fz-foq.1.

Its only coupling to the lib is `use super::handler::EventKind` (6 occurrences of a plain enum), so a fz-foq.1-style extraction to a dev-dependency crate is feasible; the crate would depend on fz for EventKind, which cargo permits because the fz -> crate edge is a dev-dependency.

Needs a decision before proceeding -- see the rewritten description.

title: Move causal totals helpers into the CLI test
